Definition: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of G1074; birth:--birth.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, genetḗ means birth. It occurs just once, in John.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe genetḗ needs no more than its plain sense — birth.
RelatedEvents: The Healing of the Man Born Blind
